comparison.objective: Finish four threaded inserts by tang removal; record calibrates a colorimeter with a blank and measures a sample.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate needs impact-tool alignment, bimanual striking, and fragment pickup; record needs cuvette identification/orientation, instrument sequencing, button use, and careful return.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures and recovered tangs with no damage; record requires a valid blank reference, wavelength-specific reading, and both cuvettes returned without loss. Candidate numeric physics thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Reference-dependent measurement and vessel handling test a different ability from impact fracture and debris recovery.
